gitCommit.subject: fix: await background processing to ensure imageIds persist on canvas save (#1357)
gitCommit.body:
fix: await background processing to ensure imageIds persist on canvas save (#1357)

* fix: await background processing to ensure imageIds persist on canvas save

AI-generated images via Gemini/GPT were disappearing after page refresh because
the background processing (S3 upload, Image record creation) ran asynchronously
while the canvas auto-save could fire before imageIds were populated on the
canvas object. Now we await triggerBackgroundProcessing synchronously so imageIds
is returned immediately and included in the canvas object before any save occurs.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: ensure generated imageIds persist across all generation paths

Read fresh canvas objects from Zustand store at save-execution time
instead of using closure-captured render state, await parallel generation
in agent tool handler, and unify event-based cache updates across
Gemini/GPT, ComfyUI obj_key, and ComfyUI base64 paths so that
saveImmediately() is always triggered after imageIds are set.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
